content.value: Write geometrical interpretation of scalar triple product. Find the volume of tetrahedron having 12 vertices $( - \hat { J } - \hat { k } ) , ( 4 \hat { l } + 5 \hat { J } + q \hat { k } ) , ( 3 \hat { \imath } + 9 \hat { J } + 4 \hat { k } ) , 4 ( - \hat { \imath } + \hat { J } + \hat { k } )$ . Also find the value of q for which these four points are coplanar.
